title: The Basics - Mirror Trading International
description: This video is about The Basics of the Mirror Trading International Opportunity Sign up today: ...

asr.full_text: Mti the basics. No trading knowledge is necessary. You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of bit coin. Your bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday. Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly. You can add to your trading accounts when and if you want. Withdrawals take up to 48 hours to process. If you just want to invest, that is all you need to know. If you want to refer other people you will get 10% Direct Referral Commission Once you start building a team, to qualify for binary bonuses you need $200 in your own position and two direct referrals. Make money! There are more detailed videos available describing the business, how to register and fund your account, understanding the binary etc. should you wish to learn more. If you have questions or want more information please contact CLINT.

Your bitcoin balance grows slowly and steadily with an anticipated increase of 10% to 13% monthly.

textual.context: Promotional or instructional presentation of an investment opportunity; the return is described as anticipated rather than explicitly guaranteed in the source record.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated monthly-return expectation is directly linked to providing at least $100 in Bitcoin and a stated withdrawal process, creating a relationship for later review of the offer's terms and context.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether trading occurred, whether returns were achieved, whether funds were lost, or whether the claims were independently verified.

textual.observation: The recording describes referral commissions and binary bonuses tied to referring other people, building a team, maintaining $200 in one's own position, and obtaining two direct referrals.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether payments were made, the full compensation plan, who receives funds, or the complete terms of participation.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a branded trading-pool offer requiring at least $100 in Bitcoin while associating the contribution with a potential 10% to 13% monthly balance increase. It also offers referral commissions and binary bonuses tied to maintaining a financial position and obtaining two direct referrals, while directing viewers to account registration and funding information. The monthly figure is qualified as historical and not guaranteed, and no outcomes or payments are established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer requires joining a trading pool with Bitcoin and presents an anticipated 10% to 13% monthly balance increase. This is an investment-pool or managed-trading returns relationship. The video also promotes income qualification through a team and direct referrals, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.
